mission: Collect emails and survey answers from a landing page's form (an ad's destination, say), confirm them by email when a mail service is set up, and let the owner and their agents read, count, and export them. Visitors can only add or update their own entry; nothing they send is shown to anyone but the owner.

tool.description: List leads (newest first): email, name, survey answers, UTM source/medium/campaign/content, confirmed or not, and when. Filter by campaign or by text.
Count leads per campaign (total and confirmed), per UTM source and ad (utm_content), and per day for the last 30 days. Use it to see which ads bring people in.
Tally the answers to one survey question in a campaign: each distinct answer and how many gave it.
Every lead of a campaign as CSV text (email, name, confirmed, created, UTM fields, then one column per survey question).
